about: Segmentation cases shared by tools/voices/textsplit.py (test_textsplit.py) and the JVM ICU sentence path (IcuSentencesFixtureTest). No boundary may fall inside a 'protect' span; 'sentences' is the expected sentence count. 'corpus' holds the 18 shipped lines the QC of 2026-10-30 found corrupted (evidence.json numeric_reproductions); every numeric span in them is protected.
